data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘ar-r-s’, meaning ‘to exalt, to elevate’. In Islamic context, Aroosha symbolizes the highest degree of nobility and purity. The name Aroosha carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aroosha usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aroosha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
